segmentName: EMV Terminal Floor Limits Data Segment
scope: Segment DL8 EMV floor-limit download segment ('%' + 3-digit Segment Length + 1-24 repeating 26-byte Floor Limit Data groups), gated by a terminal-level Special and sharing DL7's hybrid framing convention

rules.title: Segment DL8 contains EMV floor limits (as RID) for the terminal; inclusion in a table load depends on a 'Special' flag set at the terminal level; the data is maintained at the BUYPASS Host, and changes to it set the table download flag for all terminals with the Special flag
rules.note: DL8's position in the Table Load Response is not given in 11.7.1.2 or the Chapter 12 matrix (SEGDL8-SME-002).

rules.title: Data Type Indicator is fixed value '%' (Element 24); Segment Length Indicator (Element 84, 3 digits) is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length, same hybrid framing convention as Segment DL7 (no End-of-Data Indicator)
rules.note: Own-digit counting follows the DL7 decision (SEGDL7-SME-005); the 'Source: Device' label is part of SEGDL8-SME-002.

rules.title: Floor Limit Data repeats per RID, for a maximum of 24 RIDs, total variable length up to 624 bytes; each repetition contains RID (233,10, Host-sourced), Stand-in Indicator (234,1, Host-sourced), Floor Limit (235,12, Host-sourced, maximum allowable stand-in value), BUYPASS RID Card Type (236,3, Host-sourced)
rules.note: Each group is 10 + 1 + 12 + 3 = 26 bytes; 24 x 26 = 624, which confirms the stated maximum.

rules.title: RID (Element 233) is AN fixed 10 and must be a valid EMV Registered Application Provider identifier; Stand-in Indicator (Element 234) is N1 with values 1 (No Stand-in), 2 (Domestic only Stand-in), 3 (Domestic & Foreign Stand-in); Floor Limit (Element 235) is N fixed 12, 000000000000-999999999999; BUYPASS RID Card Type (Element 236) is AN fixed 3
rules.note: Element 236 lists no valid values and the RID representation (hex text of the 5-byte RID) is not stated (SEGDL8-SME-003).

rules.title: The DL8 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits and must describe a whole number (1-24) of 26-byte Floor Limit Data groups after the Data Type Indicator
